title: PlanGraph-style baseline vs X-Ray
disclaimer: Synthetic fixture comparison of multi-query BFS / first-edge ownership versus X-Ray typed faultlines and authority-ranked ownership. Does not claim a head-to-head win against the PlanGraph product.
limitations: Measured on a labelled synthetic corpus, not a shared enterprise PlanGraph benchmark.
Naïve round-trips count client BFS calls; a real PlanGraph deployment may batch differently.
